commit_message_template: v49.0: Day 197 — Sep 11-12 exchange drives F6 to 55%; F3 and F4 collapse on stalled diplomacy and Hormuz contradictions
direction_of_travel: The Sep 11-12 exchange, the heaviest in 30 days, drove F6 to 55% (IRGC follow-on strike before Sep 15) and collapsed F3 to 9% (indirect session closes Sep 17 without a scheduled meeting), while F4 fell to 11% after IRGC mine-deployment directly contradicted the Hormuz recovery timeline.
